fr.question_text: Un véhicule est signalé à contresens sur mon autoroute. Quelle conduite adopter ?
fr.answer_a: Je renonce à dépasser et rejoins la prochaine aire accessible en gardant mes distances.

fr.answer_c: Je m’arrête immédiatement sur la voie de droite.

en.answer_d: Continue driving along the emergency shoulder.
en.explanation: A wrong-way alert calls for extra caution. Avoid overtaking, keep a safe gap and stop at the next accessible rest area. Do not use the emergency shoulder to continue driving or to wait out the alert.

fr.question_text: Après environ deux heures de conduite sur autoroute, je me sens encore alerte. Quelle bonne habitude adopter ?
fr.answer_a: Attendre les premiers bâillements pour faire une pause.
fr.answer_b: Faire une pause d’environ 15 à 20 minutes sur une aire.
fr.answer_c: Continuer deux heures de plus en ouvrant la fenêtre.
fr.answer_d: Remplacer la pause par un café bu en roulant.
fr.explanation: Il est recommandé de prévoir une pause d’environ 15 à 20 minutes au moins toutes les deux heures, même sans fatigue ressentie. Si la somnolence apparaît plus tôt, je m’arrête dès que possible dans un lieu sûr.

en.answer_c: Drive for another two hours with the window open.
en.answer_d: Replace the break with coffee while driving.
en.explanation: Plan a break of about 15 to 20 minutes at least every two hours, even if you do not feel tired. If drowsiness appears sooner, stop as soon as possible in a safe place.

en.explanation: Under the same conditions, braking distance increases approximately with the square of speed, so doubling speed multiplies it by four. This describes braking distance, not the whole stopping distance on its own.

en.question_text: While driving, the red oil-pressure warning stays on with the STOP alert. What should I do?
en.answer_a: Continue until the next scheduled service.
en.answer_b: Stop safely as soon as possible, then switch off the engine.
en.answer_d: Leave the engine idling for a long time.
en.explanation: A persistent oil-pressure alert may indicate inadequate lubrication. Stop as soon as it is safe, then switch off the engine and seek appropriate assistance. Do not continue the journey.

proposals.visual_review: Corrected close-up reviewed: red oil-can with droplet and STOP clearly visible on actual dashboard display; misleading auxiliary gauges removed from frame. Question supplies persistent warning while driving; B stops safely before switching engine off. Both languages and four options checked against manufacturer guidance.
